sentences.text:
-----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
-----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Praveen Shankar Dayal, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Sudhir Kumar Mahto, A.P.P.
 -----
02/16.05.2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for
 the State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Gola P.S. Case No.72/2023,
registered for the alleged offence under Sections 376, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in
the Court of the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ramgarh.

3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the informant is a major lady and she has come in relationship with the petitioner after death of her husband and relationship was continuing and all of a sudden, the present case has been lodged.
He submits that family members were not ready for marriage of the petitioner with the lady.
He submits that the relationship was consensual.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer on the ground that the allegations of Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code is there.

5. Considering that the informant is a major lady and after death of her husband, she has come in relationship with the petitioner, which appears to be consensual one and in the attending facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
6.

Accordingly, the above-named petitioner is directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Ramgarh in connection with Gola P.S. Case No.72/2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Angat Karmali vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
